description: Power curve with turbulence correction and air-density adjustment for AWE. Turbulence correction uses second-order Taylor expansion. Air density accounts for altitude (AWE operates at 200-600 m), temperature, and humidity.

system.name: Generic 100 kW AWE System (Kite/Wing Ground-Gen class, Ampyx AP3 / Kitemill class)
system.source: Fagiano & Milanese (2012) Automatica; Luchsinger (2013) Energies; Diehl (2013) AWE book; AWES roadmap 2019

glide_ratio.note: Effective lift-to-drag ratio during pumping cycle

power_curve.description: Semi-empirical AWE power curve at rho_ref=1.225 kg/m3 (pumping-cycle ground-gen). Based on AWE performance models: P ~ 2/27 * rho * A * v^3 * (L/D)^2 / (1 + (L/D)) scaled by system efficiency.
power_curve.source: Loyd (1980) J. Energy; Fagiano & Milanese (2012) Automatica; AWES Industry Report (2019)

Rd.note: Specific gas constant for dry air

turbulence_intensity.note: AWE at altitude: lower TI than surface, typically 0.05-0.15
